Guidance for Claude Code (claude.ai/code). MVP demo: full-stack budget tracker. Prefer simple, readable, composable code; clear names over generic names like Repository, Service, Manager, etc.; Avoid using comments to overexplain everything; No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead.

Backend: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal Web API/EF Core in `src/BudgetTracker.Api/`, feature folders `Auth/`, `AntiForgery/`, Identity cookies + Static API keys. Frontend: React 18/TypeScript strict/Vite/Tailwind, React Router v7, Axios, authentication, anti-forgery, multi-tenant isolation, CSV import, Azure OpenAI insights/recommendations, pgvector semantic search, background AI processing, NLP query assistance. PostgreSQL; user isolation enforced at database query level; API keys via `StaticApiKeysConfiguration`; conditional anti-forgery filtering. Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest); tests use snake_case: `Should_do_when_something`; Testcontainers; NSubstitute preferred.

Commands:
dotnet watch run
dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName
dotnet ef database update
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run lint
docker compose up -d
docker compose down

Connection: `Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=budgettracker;Username=budgetuser;Password=budgetpass123`
API http://localhost:5295, frontend http://localhost:5173, Swagger http://localhost:5295/swagger; CORS ports 5295/5173. When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
